qualification: Required target inventory; presence does not imply implementation or passing tests.

components.name: AppTheme
components.contract: Resolve typed appearance and metrics for descendants with reactive system mode and explicit overrides.
components.verification: Change system mode, apply override, corrupt saved preference and verify mode/contrast precedence.

components.name: AppSurface
components.contract: Apply semantic background, content color, shape and optional interaction without owning data.
components.verification: Verify inherited content color, clipping, enabled interaction and opaque readability.

components.name: AppCard
components.contract: Group caller content with semantic container variants and optional action.
components.verification: Exercise long content, selectable versus passive semantics and disabled click suppression.

components.name: AppDivider
components.contract: Separate content with tokenized thickness and orientation.
components.verification: Check bounds, contrast variants and absence of redundant accessibility announcements.

components.name: AppScrim
components.contract: Dim underlying content and expose only the caller-approved dismissal action.
components.verification: Verify layering, hit interception, disabled dismissal and accessibility focus exclusion.

components.name: AppText
components.contract: Render shared typography with caller text, overflow and semantic configuration.
components.verification: Check font scale, multiline overflow, RTL and exact bundled font selection.

components.name: AppLabel
components.contract: Provide reusable control labels with explicit association and emphasis.
components.verification: Verify required/disabled indication and one associated accessible label.

components.name: AppIcon
components.contract: Render shared vector assets with explicit meaningful or decorative semantics.
components.verification: Test tint, sizing, directional mirroring and omitted decorative descriptions.

components.name: AppImage
components.contract: Display an already available image with controlled size, scale and description.
components.verification: Test aspect ratio, clipping, missing content and meaningful versus decorative semantics.

components.name: AppAvatar
components.contract: Present person-neutral image or initials fallback in a consistent shape.
components.verification: Test missing image, empty/long initials, clipping and readable fallback.

components.name: AppBadge
components.contract: Show bounded count or status without replacing the associated control label.
components.verification: Test zero/overflow counts, text scaling and nonduplicated announcements.

components.name: AppTopAppBar
components.contract: Arrange title and caller-owned leading/trailing actions with shared appearance.
components.verification: Test long title, target sizes, insets and action reading order.

components.name: AppToolbar
components.contract: Arrange contextual caller actions without owning their workflow.
components.verification: Test overflow, disabled actions, RTL order and keyboard focus.

components.name: AppBottomActionBar
components.contract: Lay out bottom actions above owned safe-area/keyboard bounds.
components.verification: Test keyboard appearance, long labels and one application of bottom insets.

components.name: AppTabBar
components.contract: Expose top-level selection through values and callbacks.
components.verification: Test selection semantics, repeated selection and no private navigation stack.

components.name: AppTabBarItem
components.contract: Render an accessible destination item with icon, label and optional badge.
components.verification: Test selected/disabled state, long label and minimum interaction target.

components.name: AppTabRow
components.contract: Lay out related content tabs with controlled selection and scrolling.
components.verification: Test overflowing tabs, focus visibility and RTL scroll behavior.

components.name: AppTab
components.contract: Expose one related-content tab action and selected state.
components.verification: Test disabled activation, indicator placement and accessible selected role.

components.name: AppNavigationRail
components.contract: Present width-adaptive primary destinations using shared selection rules.
components.verification: Test same destination state after width change and keyboard traversal.

components.name: AppBackButton
components.contract: Emit a history-back request with shared directional icon and label.
components.verification: Test RTL mirroring, disabled root behavior and exactly one callback.

components.name: AppCloseButton
components.contract: Emit presentation dismissal independently of navigation-back semantics.
components.verification: Test accessible close label, hit target and caller-controlled dismissal.

components.name: AppPageIndicator
components.contract: Expose current page and optional page selection with bounded counts.
components.verification: Test empty/single/multiple pages, invalid index protection and current-page announcement.

components.name: AppListItem
components.contract: Arrange caller text, leading/trailing slots and optional action in a stable row.
components.verification: Test large text, multiple lines, row target and passive versus interactive semantics.

components.name: AppNavigationListItem
components.contract: Expose a row action that requests navigation without owning a route.
components.verification: Test disclosure direction, action count and enabled/disabled focus behavior.

components.name: AppSection
components.contract: Group related content with caller header/footer and tokenized gaps.
components.verification: Test nesting, long content and logical semantic reading order.

components.name: AppSectionHeader
components.contract: Render a section heading with optional action slot.
components.verification: Test heading semantics, large type and distinct action label.

components.name: AppSectionFooter
components.contract: Render explanatory section content with shared supporting typography.
components.verification: Test wrapping, contrast and reading order after section content.

components.name: AppDisclosureGroup
components.contract: Expose controlled expansion with accessible content and indicator.
components.verification: Test expanded state, focus after collapse and nested actionable children.

components.name: AppButton
components.contract: Expose semantic emphasis/role/size plus enabled and busy behavior.
components.verification: Test loading suppresses duplicate actions, destructive style and minimum target at large text.

components.name: AppIconButton
components.contract: Expose one labelled action through an icon-only visual.
components.verification: Test required accessible label, disabled/loading behavior and padded target.

components.name: AppIconToggleButton
components.contract: Expose selected button state separately from switch semantics.
components.verification: Test selected announcement, exactly one change callback and disabled interaction.

components.name: AppFloatingActionButton
components.contract: Present a floating action with shared placement-independent styling.
components.verification: Test busy/disabled actions, overlap bounds and focus visibility.

components.name: AppExtendedFloatingActionButton
components.contract: Present a floating icon-and-label action that grows for content.
components.verification: Test long labels, enlarged text, icon description policy and target size.

components.name: AppSwitch
components.contract: Expose a caller-owned boolean setting using switch semantics.
components.verification: Test on/off value, disabled state, label association and callback count.

components.name: AppCheckbox
components.contract: Expose caller-owned checked state and associated label.
components.verification: Test checked/unchecked, non-gesture activation and disabled changes.

components.name: AppTriStateCheckbox
components.contract: Expose checked, unchecked and mixed states explicitly.
components.verification: Test mixed announcement and caller-defined transition without implicit domain policy.

components.name: AppRadioButton
components.contract: Expose one mutually exclusive option with caller-owned selection.
components.verification: Test selected role, label, disabled state and action count.

components.name: AppRadioGroup
components.contract: Coordinate accessible grouping while selection remains caller-owned.
components.verification: Test single selection, keyboard movement and disabled option skipping.

components.name: AppSegmentedControl
components.contract: Group related choices with controlled selection and shared geometry.
components.verification: Test overflow/long text, one selected choice and RTL layout.

components.name: AppSegmentedControlItem
components.contract: Expose one related-choice action and selected state.
components.verification: Test focus/selected distinction, disabled activation and label scaling.

components.name: AppFilterChip
components.contract: Expose filter selection through caller-owned state.
components.verification: Test toggle semantics, disabled selection and long label target.

components.name: AppInputChip
components.contract: Represent selected input with optional distinct removal action.
components.verification: Test removal does not also toggle, focus transfer and accessible removal label.

components.name: AppAssistChip
components.contract: Expose a contextual action without invented selection state.
components.verification: Test action semantics, disabled/busy behavior and icon/label ordering.

components.name: AppSuggestionChip
components.contract: Expose a suggested action or value through a callback.
components.verification: Test long text, callback identity and absence of false selected semantics.

components.name: AppSlider
components.contract: Expose bounded caller-owned scalar values with accessible adjustment.
components.verification: Test clamping, increments, RTL mapping and non-drag adjustment.

components.name: AppRangeSlider
components.contract: Expose ordered bounds with individually identifiable handles.
components.verification: Test crossing policy, constraints, handle labels and accessible adjustment.

components.name: AppStepper
components.contract: Expose bounded increment/decrement with discrete step policy.
components.verification: Test extrema disablement, repeated presses and one value change per action.

components.name: AppTextField
components.contract: Wrap single-line framework editing with labels, validation and IME configuration.
components.verification: Test composing range, paste/selection, submit, read-only/disabled distinction and error association.

components.name: AppPasswordField
components.contract: Preserve secure editing and caller-controlled reveal behavior.
components.verification: Test masking/reveal semantics, selection and exclusion from restoration/captures.

components.name: AppTextArea
components.contract: Wrap multiline editing that can grow and cooperate with scrolling.
components.verification: Test newline/IME policy, long text, cursor visibility and keyboard avoidance.

components.name: AppSearchField
components.contract: Expose editing, clear and search submission as distinct caller actions.
components.verification: Test clear versus submit, composing text, cancellation and accessible labels.

components.name: AppSelectField
components.contract: Display a controlled selection and request a shared selection presentation.
components.verification: Test placeholder, invalid/disabled states and cancel without changing value.

components.name: AppCodeField
components.contract: Expose constrained nonpersistent code editing with framework input behavior.
components.verification: Test full-code paste, backspace, focus movement and no disk restoration.

components.name: AppDatePicker
components.contract: Expose locale-aware constrained date-only selection with draft confirmation.
components.verification: Test leap day, year/month bounds, RTL calendar and cancel without commit.

components.name: AppDateRangePicker
components.contract: Expose a constrained date-only interval with explicit incomplete draft state.
components.verification: Test reversed/partial ranges, bounds, confirmation and cancellation.

components.name: AppTimePicker
components.contract: Expose constrained local time selection with explicit confirmation.
components.verification: Test 12/24-hour presentation, range constraints, locale and cancellation.

components.name: AppFormField
components.contract: Associate a caller editor with label, required, support and validation slots.
components.verification: Test semantic association, layout growth and focus/error navigation.

components.name: AppFieldLabel
components.contract: Render required and enabled field-label states without owning input.
components.verification: Test required announcement, wrapping and disabled readability.

components.name: AppSupportingText
components.contract: Render help content consistently with its associated control.
components.verification: Test multiline text and semantic ordering without duplicate announcements.

components.name: AppValidationMessage
components.contract: Present accessible sanitized validation feedback for a field.
components.verification: Test message changes, error association, long strings and actionable correction.

components.name: AppDropdownMenu
components.contract: Present anchored caller-controlled menu content with focus management.
components.verification: Test screen-edge bounds, outside/back dismissal, RTL anchoring and focus return.

components.name: AppDropdownMenuItem
components.contract: Expose one menu action with optional icon and checked state.
components.verification: Test disabled action, checked announcement and caller-owned dismissal.

components.name: AppContextMenu
components.contract: Expose contextual actions through pointer and accessible alternatives.
components.verification: Test long press and non-gesture entry, selection preservation and cancellation.

components.name: AppPopover
components.contract: Present anchored nonmodal content with controlled dismissal and bounds.
components.verification: Test anchor movement, clipping, keyboard/inset changes and focus policy.

components.name: AppTooltip
components.contract: Provide supplemental help without replacing the accessible control label.
components.verification: Test focus/hover timing, dismissal and no blocking of primary actions.

components.name: AppDialog
components.contract: Host caller dialog content with controlled modality and dismissal.
components.verification: Test focus confinement/return, outside/back policy and large content.

components.name: AppAlertDialog
components.contract: Present an alert and caller-defined actions using shared styling.
components.verification: Test action order, long message and disabled/busy actions.

components.name: AppConfirmationDialog
components.contract: Present a consequential confirmation with distinct confirm/cancel intents.
components.verification: Test cancellation never confirms, duplicate suppression and focus default.

components.name: AppModalBottomSheet
components.contract: Present controlled sheet content with gesture, keyboard and dismissal policy.
components.verification: Test drag reversal, safe areas, focused lower fields and dirty dismissal cancellation.

components.name: AppCircularProgressIndicator
components.contract: Expose indeterminate or bounded determinate progress.
components.verification: Test progress semantics, clamping, reduced motion and busy announcement.

components.name: AppLinearProgressIndicator
components.contract: Expose linear indeterminate or bounded determinate progress.
components.verification: Test RTL, range bounds, reduced motion and visible track contrast.

components.name: AppSkeleton
components.contract: Reserve meaningful loading geometry without announcing decorative placeholders.
components.verification: Test reduced-motion static rendering and stable layout when content arrives.

components.name: AppBanner
components.contract: Present persistent contextual status with optional action/dismissal.
components.verification: Test severity semantics, wrapping, action callback and controlled dismissal.

components.name: AppSnackbar
components.contract: Present transient feedback with caller action and accessibility-aware lifetime.
components.verification: Test action once, timeout policy, long text and announced message.

components.name: AppGlassHost
components.contract: Own effect sources, capture lifetime and resolved profile without leaking vendor types.
components.verification: Test source disposal, coordinate changes, policy overrides and absence of self-capture.

components.name: AppGlassSurface
components.contract: Render a semantic effect surface with functionally equivalent opaque fallback.
components.verification: Test all profiles, moving backgrounds, clipping and unchanged hit testing.

components.name: AppScreenScaffold
components.contract: Arrange top/content/bottom slots with explicit inset ownership.
components.verification: Test keyboard/system insets, scrolling under controls and no double padding.

components.name: AppScreenHeader
components.contract: Arrange screen title, supporting content and caller actions.
components.verification: Test large text, heading semantics, wrapping and focus order.

components.name: AppFormScaffold
components.contract: Arrange form content and actions with keyboard-aware scrolling.
components.verification: Test focused-field visibility, bottom actions and validation focus movement.

components.name: AppListDetailLayout
components.contract: Adapt list/detail presentation to shared width rules without losing state.
components.verification: Test width transitions, selected item, scroll retention and hierarchy-aware back.

components.name: AppAsyncContent
components.contract: Select explicit asynchronous presentation while retaining usable content on refresh.
components.verification: Test initial/refresh/empty/error/offline transitions and cancellation.

components.name: AppLoadingState
components.contract: Present an accessible initial loading state distinct from refresh.
components.verification: Test busy announcement, reduced motion and optional caller cancellation.

components.name: AppEmptyState
components.contract: Present meaningful absence with optional caller action.
components.verification: Test heading/description/action order and long text.

components.name: AppErrorState
components.contract: Present sanitized failure and caller-controlled recovery.
components.verification: Test retry suppression, message privacy and error/action semantics.

components.name: AppOfflineState
components.contract: Present unavailable connectivity as a distinct recoverable condition.
components.verification: Test retained content, retry action and transition back to usable content.

components.name: AppPullToRefresh
components.contract: Expose refresh gesture and accessible alternative with caller in-flight state.
components.verification: Test nested scrolling, retained content, duplicate requests and cancellation.

components.name: AppSwipeActions
components.contract: Expose row actions through swipe and accessible non-gesture entry.
components.verification: Test reveal/cancel, destructive action confirmation ownership and RTL.

components.name: AppPaginationFooter
components.contract: Present page loading, retry and completion without owning data fetching.
components.verification: Test duplicate page suppression, retained items and retry after failure.

components.name: AppModalHost
components.contract: Own presentation layering and focus while workflows own open/dismiss intent.
components.verification: Test one active ownership path, stacked requests, cancellation and focus return.

components.name: AppFullScreenModal
components.contract: Present full-screen workflow content with explicit close/back behavior.
components.verification: Test safe areas, dirty dismissal routing and entry disposal.

components.name: AppSnackbarHost
components.contract: Queue transient messages with action, cancellation and lifecycle ownership.
components.verification: Test ordering, duplicate handling, disposed entries and accessible timing.

components.name: AppAsyncImage
components.contract: Wrap image loading behind stable shared API with bounded decode size.
components.verification: Test deterministic loading/error, cancellation, cache reuse and no network dependency in unit tests.
